The '''Twin Stars of Kira''' were a pair of [[Star/Legends|stars]]&mdash;[[Lazerian (star)|Lazerian]] and [[Ropagi/Legends|Ropagi]]&mdash;that served as the endpoints of the [[Kira Run]] [[Hyperspace route/Legends|hyperlane]]. As a result of the expansion of culture, the meaning of the term "Twin Stars of Kira" became misleading over [[time]]. While it could be assumed to be a [[Binary star/Legends|binary star]] [[Star system/Legends|system]], it in fact referred to both stars on the end of the Kira Run, which itself contained the similarly named [[Kira system/Legends|Kira system]]. Lazerian and its [[Lazerian system/Legends|system]] intersected the Kira Run with the [[Harrin Trade Corridor]], while the [[Ropagi system/Legends|Ropagi system]] intersected with the [[Enarc Run/Legends|Enarc Run]]. Across the length of the Kira Run, the Twin Stars were two [[Standard hour/Legends|hours]] apart via [[Hyperspace/Legends|hyperspace]]<ref name="TSoK">[[Twin Stars of Kira (sourcebook)|''Twin Stars of Kira'']]</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
The Twin Stars of Kira were created by [[John Terra]] and introduced in [[Twin Stars of Kira (sourcebook)|''Twin Stars of Kira'']], a [[1993]] supplement to [[West End Games]]' ''[[Star Wars: The Roleplaying Game]]''.<ref name="TSoK" />
